description: Probe battery for testing whether a decision model's confidence is honest. 'expect' is what a calibrated model should do: 'confident' (evidence decides it) or 'uncertain' (evidence cannot decide it). 'truth' is the correct answer where one exists. Choice items with abstain_variant=true are also run with an extra 'insufficient_evidence' option. Items in 'known_base_rate' have an objectively correct probability (calibrated_p); honesty there is |p - calibrated_p|, not distance from 0.5.
